links.rationale: Current manufacturer describes 2.0 spraying walls and ceilings; it can address open-surface coating within the larger painting task.
limitations: Masking, cutting in, sloped/complex geometry, coating supply and finish inspection are not established as automated.
The exact 2.0 technical envelope and achieved site performance remain unresolved.

links.rationale: The wall pillar is designed for wall spraying and has a manufacturer-described room demonstration.
limitations: This configuration covers wall surfaces, not the ceiling portion of the task.
Masking, detailed edges, paint servicing and drying remain separate; advertised spray rate is not complete-job throughput.

links.rationale: The ceiling pillar is designed for ceiling spraying and has a manufacturer-described room demonstration.
limitations: This configuration covers ceiling surfaces, not the wall portion of the task.
Access, masking, boundary areas and material supply require people; no full-shift accepted-area denominator is published.

links.rationale: The exact EG7 product page describes coating application using the scanning platform and exchangeable tools.
limitations: Match coating, substrate and reachable surface before a trial; German supply remains unconfirmed.
Preparation, masking, edges, refilling and recovery effort are outside the reviewed application claim.

links.rationale: EG7 offers drywall finishing and a sanding configuration that exchanges the coating hopper for dust collection.
limitations: Sanding/coating capability does not establish automatic taping, screw treatment, corner finishing or drying management.
German Q-level acceptance, material compatibility and exact EG7 production results require a site trial.

links.rationale: The 1200CX launch describes robotic joint-compound application followed by sanding with an interchangeable head.
limitations: Human preparation, taping, drying, changeover and final acceptance remain part of the complete task.
US Level 4/5 claims do not establish German Q classifications; German orderability and support remain unconfirmed.

links.rationale: The manufacturer documents interior concrete demolition with Brokk 110 and publishes an attachment-specific working envelope.
limitations: A human operator continuously controls demolition; this is not autonomous breaking.
Select and approve the actual attachment, structural method, dust control, power and debris handling; published reach uses a reference hammer.

links.rationale: The manufacturer documents Brokk 300 concrete crushing with a Darda attachment and publishes an attachment-specific working envelope.
limitations: A human operator continuously controls demolition; this is not autonomous breaking.
Select and approve the actual attachment, structural method, dust control, power and debris handling; published reach uses a reference hammer.

links.rationale: The manufacturer offers DXR 145 for demolition with compatible breakers and concrete crushers.
limitations: Application claim only; an exact-model productive site case with usable outcome data was not established.
Continuous human control, attachment selection, structural survey, dust control and debris logistics are required.
